n9520b203d6.headline: Housing price increases continue to accelerate. Land price growth exceeded 20% - Seznam Zprávy
n9520b203d6.summary: Residential property prices in the Czech Republic accelerated in the third quarter, with land price growth exceeding 20%, driven by high demand and inflation concerns.
n9520b203d6.why: Housing price trends reflect economic conditions and inflation pressures, affecting real estate markets and investment decisions.
